[***Journal of Epidemiology and Global Health***]{.journal} · 2024

\[[Article](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s44197-024-00200-0)\] · \[[Code & data (OSF)](https://osf.io/h68wz/)\] · \[[Shiny app](https://demomort.shinyapps.io/LE_losses2020/)\]

## \> *Estimating excess mortality at the subnational level in 21 European countries. We find evidence of a loss in life expectancy in 391 regions, with losses exceeding 2 years in 12 regions. Geographic clusters of high mortality were found in Northern Italy, Spain and Poland; low mortality clusters in Western France, Germany/Denmark and Norway/Sweden.*
